SyvPfLkkorvJJ1Ort3OOwg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)今年截至第31週累計報告11萬4,004例疑病例(78%為5歲以下兒童),1,487例死亡,已超越去年全年疫情(83,486例,死亡1,187例),其中北基伍省和南基伍省(佔47.7%)為最嚴重地區。由於武裝衝突、人口流離及多種疾病(伊波拉、霍亂與瘧疾)同時傳播等影響,導致醫療體系嚴重負擔,無國界醫師(MSF)已在北基伍/南基伍省實施介入措施,避免疫情傳播。Beacon 8/18 瑞典疫情持續,今年截至8/24累計30例確定病例,均為參與今年音樂節(7/30-8/2)相關病例,多數為18歲以下未接種過疫苗之兒童,其中以斯德哥爾摩(9例)及西博滕省(6例)為多。由於該節日吸引約萬名遊客參加,該國與各地感染管制相關部門進行接觸者追蹤,並建議未接種疫苗或接種不完整者進行自主監測。 莫三比克自2025/7/29宣布爆發疫情後,截至今年8/18累計報告2,595例確定病例,4例死亡。主要以北部南普拉省(1,137例病例,4例死亡)較為嚴重,其次為索法拉省(585例)。相較今年3月資料(697例,1例死亡),短期間內增加1,898例。
SyvPfLkkorvJJ1Ort3OOwg.en: The DRC has reported 114,004 suspected cases this year as of week 31 (78% of them children under 5), with 1,487 deaths, already exceeding last year's total (83,486 cases and 1,187 deaths). The worst-affected areas are North Kivu and South Kivu provinces (47.7%). Armed conflict, population displacement and the simultaneous spread of multiple diseases (Ebola, cholera and malaria) are placing a severe burden on the health system. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has implemented interventions in North Kivu and South Kivu to prevent transmission (Beacon, 18 August). Sweden's outbreak continues: as of 24 August this year, 30 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, all linked to this year's music festival (30 July–2 August). Most were unvaccinated children under 18, with cases concentrated in Stockholm (9) and Västerbotten (6). As the festival drew about 10,000 visitors, the country and regional infection-control authorities are conducting contact tracing and recommend self-monitoring for those who are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Mozambique has reported 2,595 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 18 August this year, including 4 deaths, since declaring an outbreak on 29 July 2025. The worst-affected area is Nampula Province in the north (1,137 cases, 4 deaths), followed by Sofala Province (585 cases). Compared with 697 cases and 1 death in March this year, cases have increased by 1,898 in a short period.

B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續擴大,今年截至8/11,累計報告近14萬例病例其中17,385例確定病例及880例死亡(98例確定),所有行政區皆有病例,主要集中於首都達卡(Dhaka Division;60,866例、404例死亡),較為嚴重,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)及巴里薩爾(Barishal),當局持續擴大疫苗接種活動。 美洲區今年截至7月中旬,累積4,7459例確定病例,44例死亡,今年累積確定病例數相較去年同期5,123例增加8倍,且為自2004年以來確定病例數最多之一年,病例數以瓜地馬拉、墨西哥、美國及祕魯最為嚴峻,合計占該洲病例數95%,另以20-29 歲年齡組病例比例最高(31%)。 美國今年截至8/13累積報告2,566例(含16例境外移入),約19% 為5歲(含)以下兒童,67%為青少年,7%患者需住院治療。主要集中於南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例);賓州為目前疫情熱區,8/17當週新增60例確定病例,迄今累計307例。另93%病患為未接種疫苗或疫苗接種史不明。 瑞典今年截至8/17報告10例疑病例,可能與7/31至8/1辦理之音樂節相關,多數病例為18歲以下兒童;該國已啟動接觸者追蹤與跨國通報,並持續監測相關疫情。
B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to expand. As of 11 August this year, nearly 140,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17,385 confirmed cases and 880 deaths (98 of them confirmed). Cases have been reported in all administrative areas and are concentrated mainly in the capital, Dhaka Division (60,866 cases, 404 deaths), followed by Chattogram and Barishal; authorities continue to expand vaccination activities. In the Americas, as of mid-July this year, 47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Confirmed cases this year are 8 times the 5,123 in the same period last year, making this one of the years with the highest number of confirmed cases since 2004. Cases are most severe in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States and Peru, which together account for 95% of the region's cases; the 20–29 age group has the highest proportion (31%). In the United States, as of 13 August this year, 2,566 cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively; about 19% were children aged 5 and under, 67% were adolescents, and 7% of patients required hospitalisation. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Pennsylvania is currently the hotspot, with 60 confirmed cases added in the week of 17 August and 307 cumulatively to date. In addition, 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Sweden reported 10 suspected cases as of 17 August this year, possibly linked to a music festival held on 31 July–1 August; most were children under 18. The country has initiated contact tracing and cross-border notification and continues to monitor the related outbreak.

_EAGwSe0TolQ2FjUpoUvzg.zh: 瑞典自去(2025)年9月至今年3月累計報告11例急性病毒性A型肝炎病例,病患年齡介於17-64歲,居住在全國不同地區,病毒型別為IA,經調查疑感染源為冷凍草莓或覆盆莓。另李斯特菌症為瑞典去年主要的食物及飲水傳染病,累計報告158例病例,疫情創歷史新高,其中,某餐廳爆發疫情,共有16例病例在用餐後生病,罹病者年齡較輕,且不屬於任何風險族群。
_EAGwSe0TolQ2FjUpoUvzg.en: From September 2025 to March 2026, Sweden cumulatively reported 11 cases of acute viral hepatitis A, in patients aged 17–64 years living in different parts of the country. The virus genotype is IA. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection was frozen strawberries or raspberries. Listeriosis was Sweden's main foodborne and waterborne disease last year, with 158 cases reported cumulatively, a record high. In one outbreak at a restaurant, 16 cases fell ill after dining there; these patients were younger and did not belong to any risk group.

IKJ8uEYwCOT3fKIQtagbhw.zh: 瑞典斯德哥爾摩於10/2報告130例疑病例,其中10例確診,4例出現敗血症,病患皆於9/23-27期間於某餐廳用餐;當局已通知約400名餐廳顧客作自我健康監測,該餐廳已停業,感染源調查中。
IKJ8uEYwCOT3fKIQtagbhw.en: Stockholm, Sweden, reported 130 suspected cases on 2 October, of which 10 were confirmed and 4 developed sepsis. All patients had dined at one restaurant between 23 and 27 September. Authorities have notified about 400 restaurant customers to conduct self-health monitoring. The restaurant has closed, and the source of infection is under investigation.

5Jd1Sgi7YBwEqXXawVnAAg.zh: 瑞典今年疫情上升,迄今累計269例病例,去年累計384例病例,可能因氣候變遷導致蜱蟲繁殖季節延長。依據確診病例數分類,該國290個城市中有173個列為風險地區,當局建議高風險地區之民眾均應接種疫苗。
5Jd1Sgi7YBwEqXXawVnAAg.en: Cases in Sweden are rising this year: 269 cases have been cumulatively reported so far, compared with 384 cases last year. Climate change may be extending the tick breeding season. Based on confirmed case numbers, 173 of the country's 290 municipalities have been designated as risk areas, and authorities recommend that people in all high-risk areas be vaccinated.

aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共10國於2025/1/7-4/23期間新增41起H5N1疫情,匈牙利13起、波蘭9起、越南7起、美國5起、瑞典2起、南韓/比利時/法國/芬蘭/立陶宛各1起。 日本於2025/4/11-4/24期間新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,031 (10)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第16週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、明蘇達、紐澤西)4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:外媒報導2024年H1N2豬流感研究,病毒於歐洲由禽類跨物種傳播至豬隻形成H1N2 1C譜系,自2011-24年間報告至少29例人類感染事件,其中近半數發生於2021年後。據調查顯示多數人對該病毒無免疫力,目前疫苗對該病毒保護效力較低;於動物實驗中,病毒可與人類呼吸道受體結合,且可在支氣管細胞中有效複製,具高度穩定性及高活性神經胺酸酶等特性,評估具有人際傳播潛力。惟現有證據顯示病毒致死率低,於豬隻感染症狀亦屬輕微,且未具高致病性,惟因具備人際傳播潛力及多數人無免疫能力,仍需持續納入監測及定期風險評估。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,601起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,601 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

maWq8YafMCSzfZ3z2_vmPw.zh: 瑞典2024年累計報告1,612例病例,為近14年來新高,病患年齡中位數為42歲,檢出型別多為腸道沙門氏菌及傷寒沙門氏菌;經調查生產自烏克蘭之雞蛋及義大利之苜蓿芽為造成當年大規模疫情的主因,各造成逾百人之感染,另境外輸入病例多來自泰國。
maWq8YafMCSzfZ3z2_vmPw.en: Sweden reported 1,612 cases cumulatively in 2024, the highest in nearly 14 years, with a median patient age of 42. The types detected were mainly Salmonella enterica and Salmonella Typhi. Investigation found that eggs produced in Ukraine and alfalfa sprouts from Italy were the main causes of large-scale outbreaks that year, each infecting more than 100 people. Imported cases mainly came from Thailand.

9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.

AyHG90I-AR9YWZezcCVkiA.zh: 瑞典於3/9報告自去年12/30截至今年2/20,已累計30例病例,皆為IIb型,多數病例在斯德哥爾摩,且均為成年男性。當局呼籲民眾倘接觸疑症狀者,應儘速接種疫苗。
AyHG90I-AR9YWZezcCVkiA.en: Sweden reported on 9 March that from 30 December last year to 20 February this year, 30 cases had been reported cumulatively, all clade IIb. Most cases were in Stockholm, and all were adult men. Authorities urge anyone who has been in contact with people showing symptoms to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

CM2phWo-72KOhzycklMfag.zh: 挪威疫情持續,自10月中旬迄今累計報告49例,其中24例住院,病例遍及全國,經檢驗42例感染新港沙門氏菌(Salmonella Newport)及7例鼠傷寒桿菌(Salmonella typhimurium),調查顯示可能的感染源為苜蓿芽。另瑞典亦刻正爆發來自同一來源的苜蓿芽產品衍生的鼠傷寒桿菌感染疫情。
CM2phWo-72KOhzycklMfag.en: Norway's outbreak continues: since mid-October, 49 cases have been reported cumulatively, 24 of whom were hospitalised, with cases across the country. Testing found that 42 cases were infected with Salmonella Newport and 7 with Salmonella Typhimurium. Investigation indicates that the likely source of infection is alfalfa sprouts. Sweden is also experiencing an outbreak of Salmonella Typhimurium infection linked to alfalfa sprout products from the same source.
